description: Give each skill only to the agents and models that can use it, so image skills reach Codex and stay out of Claude Code. Each skill carries a list of agents and optional model globs such as gpt-5*, and a thread receives only the skills that match its agent and model. A preview shows what a thread on any agent and model would get. Import skill folders from the BB machine, or ask a thread to list or change a scope; a bb scoped-skills CLI does the same. Needs no account, API key or network access.
